summary: Build smart building capability with PropTech, BMS, IoT, and ISO 41001-aligned tools. Enquire now for practical training.
lede: Smart building operations training helps property owners and operators turn connected-building systems and data into practical decisions. It covers assessing building readiness, interpreting building-management and sensor data, and prioritizing energy, maintenance, and occupant-service use cases, with practical work on governance, scorecards, and implementation roadmaps for buildings with legacy systems and mixed technology adoption.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage connected buildings, digital facilities systems, and real estate technology decisions. It gives you a common operating language for PropTech and Smart Buildings Training so you can align technical data with business outcomes.
audience: Maintenance Planning Analysts using data to improve
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with building operations, facilities management, property management, or asset management. Basic comfort with spreadsheets and dashboard-style reporting is recommended, and prior exposure to BMS, CAFM, IWMS, energy monitoring, or maintenance systems will help you move faster. No programming is required for completion, but the course assumes you can read operational data, discuss vendor solutions, and participate in technology selection and implementation planning. The more advanced concepts, including Digital Twin use cases and AI-assisted fault detection, are covered at an operational application level, not as software development or system engineering.
